caseStudyMeta.aiModelsHint: Comma-separated list of AI technologies used.

bulkImport.recentEmpty: No imports yet. Imported articles will appear here.

translationsEditor.deleteHistoryConfirm: Remove this history entry? This cannot be undone.

users.pageSubtitle: Manage who can sign in to the admin portal and what they can do.

dialog.roleNotAssignable: You can only assign roles within your own permissions.
dialog.credentialsHint: This password is shown only once. The user must change it when they first sign in.
dialog.deleteHint: This deletes the account and cannot be undone. Type the email to confirm.

roles.pageSubtitle: Roles are bundles of permissions. Users get every permission from all of their roles.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role “{name}”? It will be removed from {count, plural, one {# user} other {# users}}.

editor.name: Name
editor.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.
editor.notHeld: You can only grant permissions you have.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.subtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

studio.title: Content Studio
studio.subtitle: Draft articles from your own material, with a source for every fact.

systemCheck.title: System check
systemCheck.description: Confirms the studio worker is running and connected to the database.
systemCheck.timeout: No response after 90 seconds. Is the studio worker running?

library.title: Source library
library.empty: Material added here can be used by any project: notes, CosBE articles, PDFs.
library.linkedError: This source is used by a project or was added by someone else. Only its creator (once it is unlinked) or users who can delete studio sources can remove it.
library.allLinked: Everything in the library is already in this project.

addSource.title: Add material
addSource.pdfHint: PDFs are stored now and used once PDF reading is available. They cannot be cited yet.
addSource.tooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB.
addSource.textPlaceholder: Paste notes, a transcript or a document.
addSource.articleHint: Use a published CosBE article as material.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Name
projects.empty: A project collects the material a group of articles draws on: notes, past articles, documents.
projects.sources: {count, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}}
projects.noSources: No material yet. Add notes, an article or a PDF.
projects.descriptionHint: Optional. What the material is about.
projects.failed: Could not create the project. Try again.
projects.intro: Each project holds material that its articles can cite.
projects.materialDescription: Articles in this project can cite any of these.

pieces.title: Pieces
pieces.emptyBody: Choose the material it should be based on, say what it should achieve, and the studio drafts it with a source for every fact.

errors.BUSY: Wait for the current step to finish.
errors.LOCKED: This piece was already handed off.
errors.NO_AUTHOR: Choose an author in “Send to posts” first.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the values and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.

reasons.SOURCES_NOT_READY: Wait until a selected source has finished processing.
reasons.NO_GOAL: Describe the goal of the article in the brief.
reasons.NOT_REVIEWED: Finish writing before creating the draft post.
reasons.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE: The default template cannot be deleted.

runErrors.FORBIDDEN: You no longer have permission to run this step.
runErrors.NO_MATERIAL: “{detail}” has no source passages in the current selection. Edit the outline or the sources.
runErrors.TRANSLATION_SHAPE: The translation of “{detail}” did not keep the Japanese structure. Try again.
runErrors.TOKEN_CEILING: This step used more tokens than allowed ({detail}). Narrow the sources or ask an admin to raise the limit.

workspace.stale: Could not refresh. Showing the last loaded version.

outline.title: Outline
outline.heading: Heading
outline.sources: {count, plural, one {# source passage} other {# source passages}}
outline.boilerplateHint: Written from the brief and template only, so it cannot cite facts.
outline.gapsHint: Add material in Setup, or remove sections that depend on it.
outline.resumeHint: {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} still to write.
outline.writeHint: {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} will be written, each citing its sources.

review.title: Review

instructions.regenerate: Rewrite this section from its sources.
instructions.expand: Expand this section with more detail from its sources.
instructions.shorten: Make this section about half as long.

review.customPlaceholder: e.g. Lead with the cost figures

handoff.title: Draft created in All Posts
handoff.readOnly: Publish it from the post editor. The studio copy is read-only; a new version starts from the same brief and material.

templates.title: Templates
templates.name: Name
templates.intro: Templates set the structure and tone the writer follows.
templates.instructionsHint: Plain instructions for the writer: audience, tone, structure.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? Articles that used it keep their text.

newArticle.title: New article
newArticle.goalHint: One or two sentences: who it is for and what they should take away.
newArticle.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Show manufacturing executives what changed when a company used generative AI for sales proposals, including costs and obstacles.
newArticle.projectHint: The article can use any material in this project.
newArticle.failed: Could not create the article. Try again.

run.finishing: Writing the title, excerpt and SEO…

setup.briefDescription: What the article is for. The outline and every section follow it.
setup.goalHint: The only required field. Say who it is for and what they should take away.
setup.tonePlaceholder: e.g. Practical and polite (です・ます)
setup.keywordsHint: Press Enter or a comma to add one. Used for wording and SEO.
setup.lengthHint: In Japanese characters, roughly. Short material cannot fill a long article.
setup.templateHint: Structure and tone rules the writer follows.
setup.materialDescription: What the article may draw on. Every fact cites one of these.
setup.noMaterialHint: Paste notes, pick a CosBE article or upload a PDF.
setup.needGoal: Add a goal to create the outline.
setup.needSource: Tick at least one ready source.
setup.nextHint: Next, the studio proposes an outline you can edit.
setup.confirmOutline: A new outline replaces the current one.
setup.confirmDraft: A new outline replaces the current outline and the written draft.
setup.confirmHistory: The current version stays in History, so you can restore it.

draft.railHelp: Click a number in the text to see the passage it comes from. Click any sentence to change its wording.
draft.legendCited: The number opens the source passage
draft.transitionTitle: Transition sentence: it has no source
draft.excerptLater: The title and excerpt are written last.
draft.hint: Click a sentence to edit it, or use Rewrite on a section.
draft.incomplete: Some sections are not written yet.
draft.lockedHint: This article was sent to posts. Edit it in the post editor; the studio copy is read-only.

history.help: Each entry is the article as it was just before that change.
history.confirmBody: Restore the version saved “{label}”? The current version is kept in History first.

handoffStep.englishDescription: Optional. Carried into the draft post together with the Japanese.
handoffStep.noEnglishHint: Translate now, or create the post in Japanese only and translate it later in the post editor.
handoffStep.detailsDescription: Carried into the draft post. You can still change all of it in the post editor.
handoffStep.noAuthors: No authors yet. Add one with +.
handoffStep.excerptHint: Shown in article lists and search results.
handoffStep.needPermission: You need permission to edit posts to create the draft.
handoffStep.needAuthor: Choose an author to create the draft post.
handoffStep.hint: Creates a draft in All Posts. Publishing happens there, in the post editor.
handoffStep.confirmTitle: Send to All Posts as a draft?
handoffStep.confirmBody: A draft post appears in All Posts. Review and publish it from the post editor. The studio copy becomes read-only.
handoffStep.confirmNoEnglish: There is no English version, so the post will be Japanese only for now.
handoffStep.confirmStaleEnglish: {count, plural, one {# section's English is out of date and is left out.} other {# sections' English is out of date and is left out.}} You can translate it in the post editor.
